# Phobos Manufacturing: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.1.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Phobos Manufacturing 0.1.0 refines what the crew mines and runs the first chemistry aboard: the Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery, the X2 Chemical Processor (water electrolysis) and the H2 Hydrogen Store, with nickel-iron ingots and carbon stock as raw stock, two terminal remainders and one new minable chunk. Every charge conserves mass and is recorded with its chemistry and sources in [the refinery design record](development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md); operating instructions are in [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md). Machines are purchase-only; ores and chunks are mined, never bought; nothing new is sold in shops. Prices, salvage and repair follow the same rules as the sibling mods.

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Merchant offers request the listed finite lot when successful; separate world-loot branches retain their own listed quantities. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

**Stacking:** limits below apply to loose items on the ground or in compatible containers; 1 means no multi-item stack. Installed equipment remains individual. Limits count objects, not kilograms, and do not change merchant lot sizes or per-object contents.

<a id="v4"></a>

## V4 Volatiles Refinery

A 4 x 4 electric hearth and drying retort. One charge at a time: hydrates (10 kg) to 1 kg of water and three gangue; clay hydrates to 2 kg of water and an 8 kg anhydrous residue; carbon ore to five carbon stock, 1 kg of water, one gangue and 1 kg of CO2, CO and smoke breathed into the room; meteoric iron to four nickel-iron ingots, one gangue and 1 kg of slag; with Shipbreaker, four nickel-iron ingots and one carbon stock to four steel ingots and a melt remainder.

**Use:** Install through APPS, connect power, link a water vessel (S3 or R3 within one tile) on its panel or C1 for the water charges, load one charge into its feed (the Inventory opens the tray and the feed), then Start. 24 kW while working; part of it warms the room. Run a scrubber in its room for the carbon charge. See [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

A melt (nickel-iron or steel) left waiting for a cool room longer than its own run freezes into slag. Reload pauses it; Start resumes the bound charge. A steel charge saved before Shipbreaker is removed is kept, never overwritten. Empty the tray by hand.

Full operating instructions: [V4 Volatiles Refinery guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="x2"></a>

## X2 Chemical Processor

A 2 x 2 water electrolysis cell. Each one-hour cycle at 6 kW splits 1.125 kg of water into 1.000 kg of oxygen and 0.125 kg of hydrogen (2 H2O to 2 H2 + O2).

**Use:** Install through APPS within one tile of a water vessel and an H2 store, connect power, link both on its panel or C1, choose an installed O2 canister within one tile (or leave it on cabin air), then Start. It runs only while every output has room; a full canister or store makes it wait.

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Oxygen into the cabin raises the oxygen partial pressure, which raises the game's own fire chance. Reload pauses it; Start resumes with the held water and cycle energy kept. Cancel forfeits the cycle's energy, never the water.

Full operating instructions: [X2 Chemical Processor guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="h2"></a>

## H2 Hydrogen Store

A passive 2 x 2 pressurised store for 24 kg of electrolysis hydrogen, kept as a kilogram record (hydrogen has no game gas).

**Use:** Install through APPS within one tile of an X2 and link it from the cell. Vent hydrogen overboard from its panel or C1 (vent). Repair damage at once and vent before uninstalling.

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Damaged, it leaks about 2 kg an hour to space until repaired. With oxygen in the room and a fire, a working V4 hearth or a sparking damaged device, its contents burn: the room loses oxygen and warms, and the game's own explosion follows. Dismantling refuses while it holds hydrogen.

Full operating instructions: [H2 Hydrogen Store guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="stock"></a>

## Raw stock

Nickel-iron ingots (4 kg, cast meteoric iron: iron with a few percent of nickel) and carbon stock (1 kg) are the refinery's products and Manufacturing's raw stock. Four ingots with one carbon make steel in the V4 when Shipbreaker is present; the coming machining centre consumes ingots.

**Use:** Made in the V4. Carry, stack (ten per stack) and sell at any general buyer; feed them back into the V4 as a steel charge.

**Where it appears:** Made in the V4 from meteoric iron and carbon ore. Never sold in shops.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Four ingots ($80) are worth less than the $450 meteoric iron block and five carbon ($50) less than the $99 carbide ore: refining loses money and gains material aboard. Scrap kiosks do not buy them, so they are never furnace or processor feed.

Full operating instructions: [Raw stock guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="remainders"></a>

## Terminal remainders

Refinery slag (1 kg: sulfide, phosphide and oxide skimmings, or a frozen melt) and anhydrous residue (8 kg of baked clay minerals). Trash at the technical minimum price; nothing recovers them.

**Use:** Carry them out of the tray and sell or discard them.

**Where it appears:** Left in the V4 tray by its charges. Never sold.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Terminal: never re-processed, never the game's own Trash item.

Full operating instructions: [Terminal remainders guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="clay"></a>

## Clay hydrates

A 10 kg chunk of dark, water-rich clay minerals of the kind sampled from carbonaceous asteroids, about a fifth of it bound water.

**Use:** Bake it in the V4 for 2 kg of water and an 8 kg residue, or sell it to a government kiosk like other ore.

**Where it appears:** Mined: it turns up in the game's dark-regolith rock and C-class deposit tables as one bounded choice. Never sold.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Authored from the CI-chondrite range (18 to 22 percent water by weight) with the game's own hydrate art until its own sprite exists.

Full operating instructions: [Clay hydrates guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="compartments"></a>

## Built-in charge feed

The V4's charge feed, a named child inventory built into the machine. Not a separate product.

**Use:** Open it from the machine's Inventory and put single ore blocks, clay chunks, nickel-iron ingots or carbon stock there; the refinery binds one exact charge at a time.

**Where it appears:** Shown as feed inventory within the V4.

**Placement:** Built into its parent machine; not separately installable.

No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract.

Full operating instructions: [Built-in charge feed guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

Included compartments: Phobos' Fennmark V4 Refinery charge.

<a id="deflagration"></a>

## Hydrogen deflagration

The game's own explosion objects in three sizes, spawned for a moment when a damaged or destroyed H2 store burns. Not items.

**Use:** Not usable. They apply the game's radius damage, shrapnel and fire rolls and remove themselves.

**Where it appears:** Only at a burning hydrogen store.

**Placement:** Built into its parent machine; not separately installable.

Their entries live in the mod's data/explosions file.

Full operating instructions: [Hydrogen deflagration guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

Included compartments: Hydrogen deflagration; Hydrogen deflagration; Hydrogen deflagration.

## Evidence and upkeep

Item names, dry/template masses, prices, service bills, salvage outputs, placement tabs, stock probabilities and table recipes are generated from current Phobos definitions. **Blue Bottle Games’ Ostranauts** native `DataCO.GetBasePrice` supplies the offline valuation used here ([developer’s game page](https://bluebottlegames.com/games/ostranauts)). That page identifies the game; the actual numeric evidence is the locally inspected assembly, whose hash is retained in the generated data snapshot. No proprietary source or game assembly is distributed.

Function/use explanations are maintained in the reviewed catalogue. All fictional prices, yields and simplified processing are Phobos gameplay choices. Research attribution remains beside the relevant claims in the linked operating/research guides. See [reference maintenance](development/item-reference-maintenance.md) for the one-click updater and coverage checks.
